Title: HR Manager
Description: Own end-to-end HR operations for the plant: recruitment coordination, employee records, attendance policy support, confirmations, and statutory compliance. Partner with department heads on manpower planning and ensure HRMS masters stay accurate.

Title: CNC Operator
Description: Set up and run CNC machines to drawing, maintain tooling, record production counts, and flag quality deviations to the supervisor. Follow safety and TPM checklists on every shift.

Title: Quality Engineer
Description: Plan incoming and in-process inspection, raise NCs, support customer quality issues, and maintain inspection records. Work with Production and Final Inspection to contain defects.

Title: Design Engineer
Description: Prepare and revise manufacturing drawings, fixture concepts, and process sheets. Support shop-floor trials and close engineering change requests with Production and Quality.

Title: Accounts Assistant
Description: Process vendor bills, bank entries, and employee reimbursements. Support month-end close, TDS/GST documentation, and audit schedules under the Accounts in-charge.

Title: Sales Executive
Description: Handle customer enquiries, follow up quotations, and coordinate order fulfilment with Planning and Despatch. Maintain visit reports and support collection follow-up.

Title: IT Systems Engineer
Description: Maintain plant IT infrastructure, user access, backups, and HRMS/ERP support tickets. Coordinate with vendors for network and hardware issues.

Title: Maintenance Assistant Engineer
Description: Plan preventive maintenance for machines and utilities, attend breakdowns, and keep spare-part consumption records. Support Production in reducing downtime.

Title: Purchase Assistant
Description: Raise and track POs, follow up vendor deliveries, and update GRN status with Stores. Maintain rate comparisons and support vendor evaluation.

Title: Stores In-charge
Description: Control inventory receipts and issues, cycle counts, and min-max levels. Ensure material identification and FIFO for production kitting.
